title: Scotland's National Animal Is the Unicorn
description: Scotland chose a mythical creature as its national animal, and it has been a symbol there for centuries.

scenes.text: The national animal of Scotland is the unicorn.
It has been a Scottish symbol for hundreds of years, and it appeared on the royal coat of arms.
In old stories, the unicorn stood for purity, strength and pride, and it was said that only a king could tame one.
Many old carvings show the unicorn in chains, a sign of how wild and powerful it was believed to be.
A real country, with an imaginary animal. Follow for more weird facts.
